objective.text: Keep cache forever separate from durable storage and eviction guarantees.

difficulty.rationale: Separate an absence of TTL from a guarantee that business data survives cache loss.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A team proposes storing the only copy of issued invoice numbers with Cache::forever. Losing those records is unacceptable. What is the relevant limitation?

options.text: The problem disappears if each value includes its original creation timestamp.
options.rationale: Metadata inside a value cannot preserve that value when the cache loses it.
options.misconception: Metadata inside a value cannot preserve that value when the cache loses it.

options.text: forever guarantees persistence across all cache flushes and driver replacement.
options.rationale: A cache method cannot guarantee survival of explicit clearing or loss of its backing store.
options.misconception: A cache method cannot guarantee survival of explicit clearing or loss of its backing store.

options.text: No TTL does not guarantee retention; keep authoritative records in durable storage.
options.rationale: forever omits timed expiration, but cache eviction, flushes and store loss can still remove entries.

options.text: Reading a forever entry automatically renews it in the relational database.
options.rationale: The cache does not create an authoritative database record on read.
options.misconception: The cache does not create an authoritative database record on read.
